expected.title: Coolant and intake air temperatures disagree at key-on

evidence_json.false_positive_note: A car parked in direct sun, or driven within the last few hours (heat soak), can show this without a fault. Only trust it after the engine has sat for 6+ hours in the shade.

expected.recommended_test: Compare both sensors with an infrared thermometer on a cold engine; measure each sensor's resistance against its temperature chart.
